definitions.explanation: The temporary closure of a room or facility such as a classroom, studio, gym, or consultation room. Used on signs and notices to indicate that a space is not available on certain days.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}{休室|きゅうしつ}。
{毎週|まいしゅう}{月曜日|げつようび}は{休室|きゅうしつ}です。
{空調|くうちょう}{工事|こうじ}のため、{来週|らいしゅう}は{会議室|かいぎしつ}が{休室|きゅうしつ}になりますので、{別|べつ}の{部屋|へや}をご{利用|りよう}ください。
examples.english: Due to air conditioning work, the meeting room will be closed next week, so please use a different room.

notes:
Composed of {休|きゅう} (rest, closure) and {室|しつ} (room). Follows the same pattern as {休館|きゅうかん} (library/museum closure), {休業|きゅうぎょう} (business closure), and {休店|きゅうてん} (shop closure). Seen on signs at studios, classrooms, gyms, consultation rooms, and other facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本日|ほんじつ}{休室|きゅうしつ}: closed today
- {臨時|りんじ}{休室|きゅうしつ}: temporarily closed
- {休室|きゅうしつ}{日|び}: closure day
- {休室|きゅうしつ}のお{知|し}らせ: closure notice

RELATED WORDS:
- {休館|きゅうかん}: closure (of a library, museum, or public building) — same pattern
- {休業|きゅうぎょう}: business closure; closed for the day — for shops and businesses
- {休講|きゅうこう}: class cancellation — specifically for university lectures
- {休園|きゅうえん}: closure (of a park or kindergarten)
